description: Make another take of a song as its own track, linked to the original: a clean edit, an instrumental, acoustic, live, a remix, your own words, or the explicit original. It starts with the song's credits, lyrics and store answers; the audio, ISRC, UPC and release are its own. Counts as a song on the plan. `other_primary_artists` in the answer did not come across: tell the artist.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

dry_run.description: True to check the call and see what it would write, without writing anything.

idempotency_key.description: Send the same key if you retry, and the add happens once.

kind.description: clean_edit is marked Clean and named Radio Edit. instrumental leaves the lyrics out. explicit_original is marked Explicit, with no version words, for a Clean song with no explicit version.

remixer.description: For remix: who remixed it. Ask the artist; they get the Remixer role.

track_id.description: The song to add a version of.

words.description: For something_else: what this version is, such as Slowed. Never an artist's name, and never Clean or Explicit.

name: add_version
title: Add a version of a song
